notes: The wave extends at a speed of 400 to a max size of 825.
The Arctic Blast follows its caster.
Multiple instances of Freezing Aura do not stack.
AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
abilities.description:
Emits a freezing wave that deals 225 magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by -40% for 4 seconds.

Radius: 825

Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by -40.

Radius: 1200

additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
360 mana, 1.5 mana regeneration and 3% flat base magic resistance.
21 main attack damage to universal heroes.
name: Shiva's Guard
description: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.
trivia: The name "Shiva" is a reference to the Shiva of the Final Fantasy series, an elemental summon with the power of ice.
tips: Arctic Blast's effect hits every enemy once within its radius, even after its edge has expanded past the target. Because of its slow expansion time (taking about 2 seconds to reach max radius), it can be thought of as a moving area effect, centered on the hero. Use Arctic Blast before blinking or engaging an enemy to instantly deal area damage and movement slow upon initiation. This can be used to instantly disable enemy Blink Daggers by prematurely using Arctic Blast out of vision and then blinking onto an enemy.
